notes: Residual fix from T-0570 ADR §10 (T-0570-r iteration 2): NULL-facet carve-out for default-open READ grant was structurally sound but syntactically blinded by NULL-propagation in the AND-predicate. When scope JSON lacked keys (e.g. scope='{"kind":"node"}' without nodeId), jsonb extraction returned NULL, AND-condition cascaded to NULL, NOT(NULL)=NULL, WHERE filtered the hanging row out. COALESCE(condition, false) forces NULL→false before NOT, recovering the intended carve-out precision.
